external_sources.adaptation: Previously adopted mature BSD3 collapse widget reused for optional unassigned spawn records; binding imports remain local.
Retained native page stack and source-bound shared navigation.
Clamp the resized native page to available screen geometry using Qt logical coordinates.
Existing licensed Windows frame remains unchanged.

decision: Reuse mature native Qt/previously adopted public window and collapse code. A second browser or UI framework would duplicate the already validated local tool models and cannot supply their exact source-bound callbacks. Table-driven routing adapts the four existing families without reconstructing data.
